clue.text: Machiavelli's son married in comfort

indicators.note: in tells us the letter for married goes inside the word for comfort

parts.note: to comfort someone is to cheer them

explanation.surface: A remark about the Florentine politician's son finding marriage comfortable.
explanation.definitionFit: Machiavelli's name has become a byword for a cunning plotter, so a Machiavelli is a devious intriguer.

clue.text: Garbo film happened to suppress pain

indicators.note: to suppress something is to hold it down within, so one word encloses the other

parts.note: came, as in 'it came about', means happened
ill is used as a noun for harm or pain

explanation.surface: A Greta Garbo movie that came about despite somebody's pain.
explanation.definitionFit: Greta Garbo starred as the doomed courtesan in the 1936 film of that title, so it is an example of a Garbo film.

clue.text: Entreaty not to have lunch in the doorway

indicators.note: not to have something means it is removed from the word that precedes it

parts.note: eat stands for taking lunch

explanation.surface: A plea not to eat one's lunch standing in the doorway.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing EAT from ENTREATY leaves the letters in order.
explanation.definitionFit: An entry is a way in, such as a door or passage into a building.

clue.text: Stop for love and hold me heavenwards!

indicators.note: in a down clue, reading upwards towards heaven turns the whole run of letters back

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, shaped like the letter O
to grab is to seize hold of
taken as written

explanation.surface: A romantic plea to be clasped and lifted up towards the sky.
explanation.walkthrough: O, GRAB and ME written in order, then read upwards, gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: An embargo is an official ban on trade, which puts a stop to it.

clue.text: Aperitif for one MP in diner — and then one more

indicators.note: in tells us the pair of pieces goes inside the word for diner

parts.note: a diner is a dining car on a train, so car
one can be written as the article a
taken as written: Member of Parliament
one more 'one' gives the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A drink ordered by a politician in a dining car, and then another.
explanation.walkthrough: 'diner' is not a person eating but a railway dining car; the pair of pieces goes in after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: This Italian bitter red drink is a well-known example of a drink taken before a meal.

clue.text: Peter's brother was warned once

indicators.note: once means formerly: the answer was once the letters of the word warned, now rearranged

explanation.surface: A remark that the apostle Peter's brother had been given a warning in the past.
explanation.walkthrough: 'was ... once' hints that the answer used to be the word warned in another order.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Gospels Simon Peter's brother was the fisherman Andrew, the first disciple called.

clue.text: Country lovers are mixing apricot with it

indicators.note: mixing tells us the letters of the following words are stirred together into a new order

explanation.surface: People who love the countryside blending apricot with something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Country lovers' suggests rural folk; it means those who love their country.
explanation.definitionFit: Patriotic describes people devoted to their nation, those who love their country.

clue.text: Save half fare on a vehicle

indicators.note: half here selects the second half of the word fare

parts.note: a bicycle or cycle is a vehicle

explanation.surface: Getting a half-price ticket for a vehicle to save money.
explanation.definitionFit: To recycle waste is to save it from being thrown away by reusing it.

clue.text: Best contestant ever makes history with white horse

parts.note: a record is a history, as in a criminal record
white horses are breaking waves, so breakers

explanation.surface: A champion of all time makes history riding a white horse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'White horse' is the term for a foaming wave on the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: A record breaker beats every previous mark, so is the best performer there has ever been.

clue.text: Drop — it's the doctor's turn to take it

indicators.note: turn means the letters for doctor are turned round

parts.note: MO is Medical Officer, a doctor
taken as written

explanation.surface: A patient told it is now the doctor's turn to handle things.
explanation.definitionFit: To drop something from a list is to omit it, leaving it out.

clue.text: A grissino will fix tired backs

indicators.note: to fix the letters is to put them right by rearranging them

explanation.surface: An odd claim that an Italian snack will mend weary backs.
explanation.definitionFit: Grissino is the Italian word for a thin crisp breadstick.

clue.text: Get second chicken from this butcher

parts.note: a laying hen is called a layer

explanation.surface: Getting a second chicken from the local butcher's shop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'butcher' looks like a shopkeeper but is a killer.
explanation.definitionFit: A butcher in the sense of a ruthless killer is a slayer.

clue.text: An individual needs calm, we hear, in such a bathing suit

parts.note: an individual is one person

indicators.note: we hear tells us the word for calm is meant as spoken, giving a word that sounds the same

parts.note: calm means peace

explanation.surface: A person seeking calm in a swimsuit of a particular style.
explanation.definitionFit: A one-piece is a swimsuit made as a single garment rather than a bikini.

clue.text: Not wholly respectable group dressed in denim mode

indicators.note: dressed in the sense of arranged or prepared, so the letters are set out anew

explanation.surface: Disreputable people wearing denim fashion.
explanation.definitionFit: The demimonde is a class of people on the fringes of respectable society.

clue.text: A casserole rises with cooking

indicators.note: cooking means the letters are worked over into another form

explanation.surface: A stew rises as it cooks.
explanation.definitionFit: Irish stew is a classic slow-cooked dish of mutton, potatoes and onions, a type of casserole.

clue.text: Unlike some mothers!

indicators.note: some means only part of the word mothers is taken

explanation.surface: An exclamation about mothers who differ from others.
explanation.definitionFit: Other means different, so it can stand in for unlike.

clue.text: Instructions to turn the clock back

indicators.note: turn, with the back that follows the clock, says the word for the clock is read in reverse

parts.note: a clock is a timer; back completes the turning phrase

explanation.surface: Orders to put the clock back an hour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turn the clock back' reads as one instruction: turn and back together send the clock word in reverse.
explanation.definitionFit: A remit is a set of instructions defining the scope of one's job or task.

clue.text: Stand before gate is lifted

indicators.note: in a down clue lifting the word sends it upwards, so it reads backwards

parts.note: taken as written
ere is an old word for before

explanation.surface: Standing in front of a gate that is being raised.
explanation.definitionFit: An etagere is a piece of furniture with open shelves, a display stand.

clue.text: Vulgar actors in show

parts.note: broad humour is coarse or vulgar
a cast is the actors in a play

explanation.surface: Crude actors appearing in a show.
explanation.definitionFit: A broadcast is a programme on radio or television, a show.

clue.text: Missionary uses stone to break a stick

indicators.note: to break the stick word, another piece goes into the middle of it

parts.note: a pole is a stick
ST is the abbreviation for stone, the British weight of 14 pounds

explanation.surface: A preacher who smashes a stick with a rock.
explanation.definitionFit: The apostles were sent out to spread the faith, so an apostle is a missionary.

clue.text: Virtuous man holding foreigner to be important

indicators.note: holding means the saint abbreviation goes round the other piece

parts.note: a saint is a virtuous man, abbreviated ST
an alien is a foreigner

explanation.surface: A holy man taking in a stranger who becomes important.
explanation.definitionFit: Salient means prominent or most noticeable, hence important.

clue.text: Loafer edited lists of plants from various regions

definitions.text: lists of plants from various regions

indicators.note: edited means the letters of loafer are reworked

explanation.surface: An idler revised catalogues of regional plants.
explanation.definitionFit: A flora is a catalogue of the plants of a region; the plural covers several regions.

clue.text: Bathroom backs on to passage, one that's heavenly

indicators.note: backs means the word for bathroom is turned round

parts.note: lav, short for lavatory, is a bathroom
a hall is a passage in a house
one is the article a

explanation.surface: A bathroom backing on to a hallway that is wonderful.
explanation.definitionFit: In Norse myth this hall is the heavenly home of slain warriors.

clue.text: Nothing calls for a meeting by word of mouth

parts.note: nothing is zero, the letter O
a rally is a mass meeting

explanation.surface: Nobody calls a meeting just by telling people.
explanation.definitionFit: Orally means spoken rather than written, passed on by speech.

clue.text: Compensate at lunchtime

parts.note: taken as written
one o'clock is lunchtime

explanation.surface: Making amends over the lunch hour.
explanation.definitionFit: To atone is to make amends for a wrong, compensating for it.

clue.text: Live with Hilary, perhaps, in a tent for gain

parts.note: to be is to live or exist

indicators.note: in tells us the term goes inside the tent

parts.note: taken as written
Hilary is the spring term at Oxford, an example of a term

explanation.surface: Living with somebody named Hilary in a tent for some benefit.
explanation.walkthrough: Hilary looks like a person; it is the Oxford University spring term.
explanation.definitionFit: Betterment is improvement, a gain in one's condition.

clue.text: Yawning, having nothing to record

parts.note: nothing is zero, the letter O
to pen something is to write it down, record it

explanation.surface: Someone yawning because there is nothing to write down.
explanation.definitionFit: A yawning gap is wide open.

clue.text: Beginning to hold respect for a plant

indicators.note: to hold means the beginning word takes the respect word inside

parts.note: a seed is a beginning
awe is deep respect

explanation.surface: A small start of respect for a plant.
explanation.definitionFit: Seaweed is marine algae, loosely called a plant.

clue.text: Note about entire first half is a keepsake

indicators.note: about means the note goes round the other piece

parts.note: a memo is a note

indicators.note: first half takes the opening three of the word entire's six letters

explanation.surface: A note about the whole first half is something to keep.
explanation.definitionFit: A memento is an object kept as a reminder, a souvenir.
